ios.desc:
Slime Sports: Watch Edition is a fast, physics-based sports game built for Apple Watch. Turn the Digital Crown for pixel-precise movement and feel every hit with tuned haptics.

• Two games in one: Soccer & Volleyball  
• 60-second matches—perfect for quick breaks  
• Smart AI with multiple difficulty levels  
• Game Center achievements  
• Optimized for either wrist with configurable controls  
• Works offline; no account required

HOW TO PLAY  
• Turn the Digital Crown to move your slime.  
• Tap to jump/strike. Time your hits to score goals and volleys.

Designed for watchOS with smooth performance, readable UI, and minimal friction so you can play anywhere.
